rootCause: The VMnet8 miniport rejected Set-NetAdapter -MacAddress with Windows System Error 87. The earlier e1000e/vmxnet3 VM gate did not exercise that miniport.
fix: The host run now uses the VM-tested per-device REG_SZ NetworkAddress setting plus exact adapter restart. It requires a separately pinned VMnet-inclusive 84-observation capture and the tested VMware driver hash before mutation. Existing typed journal rollback remains independent of the new capture.

vm.scope: Two VMnet 25.0.0.1 miniports plus two vmxnet3 adapters carrying the physical-host locked value pairs. The physical Intel AX201 and Realtek hardware have not been tested by this VM gate.

tests.suite: Previous raw gate on final source

preservedFailures.description: Initial full loader selection had one Not Run registration: ib-nested-e2e-service.exe was not built. All 27 built loader tests passed; the separate scoped run excludes that registration.

One old snapshot fixture initially lacked the new preflight dependencies; seven cases passed and one failed. The fixture was updated, retaining the original platform failure and zero-mutation assertions; final 8/8 passes.

VM-only harness failures before address mutation were retained. They included missing Action, array/automatic-variable handling and a plain-reader identity join. Actual hardware verdicts use the sealed successful captures, not these harness failures.

prerequisites: Elevated Windows PowerShell at repository root
Test certificate absent from LocalMachine Root and TrustedPublisher
expectedHostActions: Temporary NetworkAddress settings and adapter restarts; automatic restoration. No PC reboot, driver install, certificate import, BCD, ESP or firmware mutation.
hashScope: Reviewed local file bytes. Manifest lists source and durable local evidence, excluding runtime temporary directories. Generated payloads, VM disks, keys and credentials are not committed.
